newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends near low, locals sell to crushers.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends near low, locals sell to crushers.

text.p: WCE canola ended near the day's lows as locals sold to crushers, traders said.

"Crushers bought all day and locals sold all day. Local selling triggered a Cargill sell stop at $401.70 at the close," a trader said. March futures crush profit margin fell to -27.43 from -26.33 Wednesday on CBOT soy oil, meal. Mar-May spread at $0.30, Mar July $1. Volume was 3,900 lots, or 78,000 tonnes, with 240 hedge lots.
March canola lost $2.40 to $402, May down $1.60 to $402.60. March flax fell $1.90 to $342.80 on commercial liquidation. Five May-July spread at $5. Volume was 173 lots.

February western barley up $0.30 to $139.30 on commercial liquidation and demand, March fell $0.50 to $137.20 with Midland Walwyn bought 400 contracts. May-July spread at $2.50, Feb-Mar legged at $2. Volume was 1,000 lots.
March feed wheat lost $0.10 to $169.50, July rose $0.10 to $162. About 230 Mar-July spread at $7.80, July-Dec $7. Volume was 1,929 lots, almost all spread trading.
Oats and feed peas did not trade.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except oats and peas.)
